name: J. S. Collins
role: Leather goods dealer (J. S. Collins & Co.)
mentions: Two wagon loads of leather goods for the Glendive branch of J. S. Collins' Cheyenne house, passed through Medora last Saturday.
We are just in receipt from J. S. Collins & Co., of one of the new "Letter Sheet Envelopes," the first we have seen. The new departure will be handy in many ways and doubtless extensively used.
